source_quality: All 260 points in-frame/masks255; validity is not surface truth. At 13468/13469/13470 the literal SCL9/8/9 labels conflict with the coherent bright island morphology; retain this contradiction explicitly. SCL8 at13345 does not resolve the reef-rim question.

blocks.finding: Three bottom-frame centres are clear wave-textured sea west of the reef.
The single centre is water within the lagoon/patch-reef field, with dark/blue NIR morphology; no exposed body at the point.
All 23 bottom sequences lie in visible sea south of the reef, including positions at the valid lower frame margin.
The isolated northeast position is clear wave-textured sea west of the reef.

Upper isolated/edge centres are water within lagoon and sea; southwest shallows are water over submerged reef. Sixteen exact positions at the fine outer reef/surf belt remain water-cover versus exposed-material questions, including the SCL8 position. Southern positions are visibly sea. No blanket cloud gap exists at these centres.
All four top-frame positions are visible sea south of the reef, within valid pixels.
The single northeast position lies in sea north of a small bright reef/island feature elsewhere; the bright feature is not at the point.
All 74 eastern-edge and central arc positions are sea west of the small island/reef. Sparse small cloudlets are elsewhere, and no opaque cover overlies these centres.

The northern western-frame grid is sea and submerged-reef water, distinct from the island to its south. Three exact centres lie on the coherent bright terrestrial island body with visible vegetation/building context, despite SCL8/9 labels. One adjacent beach-edge and seven southern breaker/reef-rim positions remain unresolved at native support. Remaining southwest/southern points are visible reef water or sea.
